evidence: Looks up CHALLENGES (0x7001d2271c), then CHALLENGE (0x7001d19a28), indexes the selected entry, reads its id field (0x7001cd3b91), and dispatches to one of several challenge-specific handlers. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0077.c:40763-40836.

Builds a path using the exact `$(PLATFORM)/CreatePlayer` template (0x7001d1d723) and `%s/%s` (0x7001c61eac), then validates resource sizes and updates the loaded resource state. Its indexed caller is in the CreatePlayer resource setup path at main_0160.c:19722. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0160.c:16855-16961; main_0160.c:19722.

Looks up the exact `left` (0x7001ce5c7d) and `right` (0x7001d32adf) keys in the supplied map pair, writes the resulting values into two context fields, and updates a status field. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0088.c:13939-13978.

Reads the exact Hide_Controller_Arrows (0x7001c64a75) and Show_Controller_Arrows (0x7001d3e60c) option names, checks related state values, chooses one of those names, and passes it with a 0xff length to the string update helper. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0081.c:41683-41790.

Resolves the CURRENT_PLAYER object (0x7001d50068), reads its `id` (0x7001cd3b91) and `type_id` (0x7001d587b0), and calls the update helper with the player id when the stored type_id is zero. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0084.c:14723-14758.

Checks for UCCHALLENGE_IS_NEW (0x7001cd4ea5); when present, reads and returns the `has_payout` value (0x7001c76b6c). No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0071.c:3547-3574.

Initializes an object with several nested subobjects and formats the exact `NPC%d` name template (0x7001ca81b2) using its slot/index argument before attaching the constructed entry. The indexed caller creates repeated entries for indices 0 through 4 and stores them in an array. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0163.c:51212-51305; main_0164.c:19594-19662.

Uses mode-dependent entry-list and sorted-entry helpers, then formats the exact `%s%s` template (0x7001c5a28a) into the supplied output record. Its indexed caller invokes it repeatedly for successive entries while building the collection. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0089.c:3655-3755; main_0089.c:3425-3591.
